description: This file defines a package-private Java interface 'JsonObjectVisitor' used for traversing and processing JSON values such as objects, arrays, strings, booleans, and nulls. It provides methods to handle different JSON types and a default method to evaluate a JsonValue by dispatching to the appropriate handler.

classes.name: JsonObjectVisitor
classes.description: A visitor interface for traversing and handling JSON structures, parameterized by type T.

methods.name: nullValue
methods.description: Handle JSON null value for a given key.

methods.name: bool
methods.description: Handle JSON boolean value for a given key.

methods.name: string
methods.description: Handle JSON string value for a given key.

methods.name: number
methods.description: Handle JSON number value for a given key.

methods.name: array
methods.description: Handle JSON array of elements for a given key.

methods.name: object
methods.description: Handle JSON object for a given key.

methods.name: eval
methods.description: Default method to evaluate a JsonValue and dispatch to the appropriate handler.

methods.name: value
methods.description: Dispatches the JsonValue to the correct handler based on its type.
